sections.text: Introduction

This document out lines the major 
 maintenance procedure P1, which must be performed every five years as 
 indicated by Y5 in the title block

The pump function: transferring boiler drain to
waste water retention basin treatment.

The first draft initiated by eng. Gamal El-Sayed 
 El-Osily, reviewed by maintenance manger eng.

 Haleem, revised by EDEPC inspection & quality 
 control eng. Samir 
 Abd-Elgalil, accepted by eng. Mohamed Abdel
 Khaffar Al-Arish Power 
 Station general manager, approved by eng Yousry Mohamed Salama head sector and 
 certified by eng Aly Mostafa Al Lethy EDEPC inspection & quality control head 
 sector.
Technical Specification
Safety Precaution

Isolate the circuit 
breaker of the pump motor

Disconnect electric terminal of
the pump motor

The pump must be isolated
mechanically by closing delivery and suction valves
Be sure pump must be completely drainage .

sections.text: Work to be Carried out
Dismantling
Remove the delivery pipe connection.
Disconnect the motor .
Unscrew the bolts and take out the motor .

Remove the coupling nuts and pins (404) alone with the coupling bushes
(400) .

Remove the coupling (390) by using suitable puller alone coupling key
(321) .

Remove the bearing cover (270-1) by unscrewing the bolts
.

Unscrew the two bearings nut (335/336) and then remove the thrust
bearing and change if needed .
Loosen the foundation bolts of motor stool and support plate (383) .

Disconnect the lubricating pipe (562-1) from motor stool
.
Remove the bolts holding motor stool .
Take out the motor stool (290) and coupling (395) .
Remove the lubricating pipe .
Lift the complete unit vertically .
Disconnect the bend (280) .

Take out casing cover from impeller and shaft assembly
.
Pull out the impeller (151) .
Remove impeller key (320) .

sections.text: Reassembly
Put the impeller shaft sleeve (311) on pump shaft (180) .
Slide impeller on shaft and tighten the impeller screw (669) with its gasket .

Fix bearing covers (271-1) with oil seals (500-4) to casing cover (220)
already felted with bearing bush (353) .
Fix bell mouth (211) on pump casing (170) .
Inspect casing cover (220) on pump shaft (186) .
Insert the whole assembly into pump casing (107) with gasket in proper position .
Mount the column pipe (132) on casing cover .
Connect pipe nipple with shaft parts of union joint to bearing cover .
Connect bend (280) to the pump casing .
Lift the unit vertically and mount strainer (216) on bell mouth .

Lift the motor stoon (290) and fix it to the
column pipe at the same time fix the lubricating pipe to motor stool .
Fix the support plate on foundation .
Tighten the foundation bolts of motor stool .
Check level of motor stool .

Fix the cover bearing alone oil seal (270-2) ,
(500-2) to thrust bearing carrier (247) .

Fit the thrust bearing (262) in the thrust bearing carrier
.
Push the thrust bearing adapter (272) on the pump shaft (180) .
Fit bearing cover alone the oil seal .

Fix the coupling key (321) and fit the flexible coupling pump shaft on
the head shaft .
Tighten the foundation bolts of the support plate .
Mount the motor half coupling (391) on motor shaft .

Mount the motor on motor spool . there should be a gap of (6mm) between the two coupling face
.
